m: वैहाली f. hunting, chase, Siṃhās.
वैहार m. (fr. वि-हार) N. of a mountain in Magadha, MBh. (cf. वैभार).
वैहारिक mfn. serving for sport or amusement, L.
वैहार्य mfn. to be played or sported with, to be conciliated by playfulness or raillery (applied to a wife's brother or brother-in-law or other relations of a wife), MBh.
वैहार्य n. playfulness, sportiveness, fun, ib.
a: वैहार्य — a. To be sported with, to be made the subject of jokes or pleasantry (said of the brother of one's wife or of the wife's relatives in general).

s: tri, (viSezeRa hrIyate iti । vi + hf + Ryat । vihAryya eva । svArTe aR .) parihAsena lAlanIyaH । SyAlasambanDyAdi । ityarjjunamiSraH ॥ yaTA, -- “yaTA bAlezu nArIzu vEhAryyezu taTEva ca । saNgarezu nipAtezu taTApadvyasanezu ca । anftaM noktapUrvvaM me tena satyena KaM vraja ॥” iti mahABArate udyogaparvva ॥

m: वैहासिक m. (fr. वि-हास) a comic actor, buffoon, actor in general, L.
a play-fellow, L.
a: वैहासिकः — 1 A jester, buffoon. --2 An actor in general.

m: वैहायन m. (also pl.) a patr. ib.
वैहायसी f. N. of a river, BhP.
वैहायस mf(ई)n. (fr. 2. वि-हायस्) being or moving in the air, suspended in the air, aerial, GṛS.; MBh. &c.
वैहायस m. pl. ‘sky-dwellers’, the gods &c., BhP.
वैहायस m. N. of partic. Ṛṣis (personified luminous phenomena), VarBṛS.
N. of a lake, MW.
वैहायस n. the air, atmosphere, MBh.
वैहायस n. flying in the air, BhP. (-गत n. id., R.)
वैहायस n. a partic. attitude in shooting, L.
a: वैहायस — a. (सी f.) Being in the air, aerial.

m: वैहायस—गत n., id., R.
वैहायसम् ind. in the open air, Āpast.
वैहीनरि See बैह्˚
वैहंग mfn. (fr. विहं-ग) id. (with रस m. ‘broth made of bird's flesh’), Suśr.
वैहग mf(ई)n. (fr. विह-ग) relating or belonging to a bird (with तनु f. ‘the body or form of a bird’), Kathās.
वैहलि m. (also pl.) a patr. Saṃskārak.
वैहती f., Pat.
वैहति m. patr. fr. वि-हत, g. तौल्वल्य्-आदि
वैह्वल्य n. (fr. वि-ह्वल) exhaustion, debility, Rājat.
